name: 2.6.5 - Press COSTAR directly
notes: Press COSTAR directly instead of clicking: boxes get the keyboard directly; Customer Waiting and the print form ticks, Print, OK, Add New and the eBay tabs are pressed directly; Work-in-Progress opens a Repair Order by making its row the active one and pressing Enter. The mouse only steps in when a direct press does not take; taking a line out is unchanged. Switch: Files and settings. Update the RDP helper; no website files.
